bead.title: Specify async lineage, idempotency, and retention frontier
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The docs do not tie async outcome retention, request_id replay, log lineage validation, and the object-log retention frontier into one release-blocking contract.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md:83` requires replay-response idempotency for `objectlog/hybrid`; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:316` describes request_id convergence; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:403` through `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:406` describe high-water, idempotency retention, manifest retention, and snapshot retention separately, leaving the async retention frontier and lineage checks underspecified.

PROPOSED FIX: Update the governing artifacts `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md`, `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`, `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`, and `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` to define durable idempotency/outcome retention for `hybrid-async`, log lineage validation from manifest through segment sequence and SQLite projection image, and a retention frontier that accounts for committed snapshots, active manifest tail, request_id retention, item-key retention, and async SQLite lag.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementation of lineage validators or retention jobs; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncLineageRetentionSpec: `rg -n 'lineage|retention frontier|idempotency|outcome retention|request_id|hybrid-async' docs/helix docs/perf` succeeds and shows lineage validation, request/outcome retention, and retention frontier rules in the governing artifacts.
2. TestHybridAsyncLineageNoCodeScope: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md`, `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`, `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`, and `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncLineageCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncLineageFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncLineageGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncLineageLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
